What ZZZ should of been!

For it being a free to play game, it has an insane amount of depth in the terms of build customization during and before the run. Changing weapon skills, a relic system, Gun fires soul ascension system (where you spent soul essence between runs), an in game relic system and skill upgrades a la gunfire. You can see your weapon/skill damage and its broken down by % and showing individual skills and damaging effects all in all Its honestly really fun so far.

The game definitely has potential. It’s a solid choice if you're looking to kill some time when you're bored or can't find anything interesting in your list. While it has some game design and UX/UI flaws, it's overall okay for this genre.

The biggest issue right now is the stuttering, which really hurts the experience. Timing is important, especially during boss fights, and the stuttering gets in the way. I know the developers are aware of it, but this is something that should have been fixed on day one.

When it comes to progression and rewards, I think the developers could take some inspiration from games like Genshin Impact or Wuthering Waves. Those games manage a good balance with their gacha systems. In Terminull Brigade, the grinding doesn't feel very rewarding, which can make it hard to stay motivated in a game that already leans heavily on grinding.

For now, I would say it's a no, but if they fix these things, it could definitely turn into something fun.

Terminull Brigade™ – Honest Review from a Real Player

Let me be 100% real here.

The gameplay is actually great. It's fast, smooth, creative, and I can see how it could be a hit. I was honestly excited to try it.

The character designs are just insane. It’s way too sexual, over the top, and uncomfortable to even look at. I’m married, and I have a kid who sometimes watches me play. I literally had to turn off the game because I didn’t feel okay launching it with my family around.

Why should I need to lock my door just to play a co-op shooter?

This has nothing to do with being religious (even though I am, and yes, this content 100% goes against my religion), but even if I wasn’t—this is just not it. It’s tasteless. It’s clearly designed for one specific type of audience and completely ignores the rest of us who just want to enjoy a game without being bombarded with this kind of stuff.

If you’re trying to make a game that lasts and reaches more people, this is not the way.

Also, the Arab gaming community is huge. Like, seriously huge. Look at esports teams like Team Falcons dominating tournaments. We love gaming. We support games. But not when they push stuff like this in our faces. You're cutting off a massive part of the world by ignoring basic decency.

Here’s one simple suggestion: add a setting or option that makes female characters look normal. That’s all. No need to ruin the visuals—just give us a choice.

If not, this game is going to die fast. Not because the gameplay sucks—but because people won’t want to open it in their own homes.

Disclaimer, I've played this game since playtest.

Although it has some shortcomings due to the issues with Ping and some server stability, the game itself is fun, as a rougue like it has a classic and arcade like feel, fast paced and effects can get crazy depending on builds, difficulty is certainly there however its all doable by yourself, yes you can solo most of the main content, i havent touched on all the content available but i'm assuming the game is possible to solo with enough knowledge of the game.

There is a gacha system which is completely optional since it doesn't give you any advantage and its purely cosmetic, the monetization of this game seems a bit odd since one of the characters is locked behind a battlepass, i believe you can unlock him through a currency on the free pass but it would take a while to unlock a character that seems very good in both kit and playstyle, i wouldnt call it pay to win itself since there is no pvp, there is MVP but as i mentioned the game is highly customizable, your build can make or break your run.

There are modules you can equip prior to a run, those affect your base stats by themselves.
Then there are in the run "relics" and "perks"
Relics are like sets of equipment that depending on the set you may obtain a different buff that affects your damage, defense, health and/or magazine capacity.
Perks similar to Hades or similar games are a set of blessings that alter the feel of your abilities and ads effects to your base kit, these can range from CC, Damage amplification, minions, Defense, etc.
Lastly there are "Potentials" these are perk like modifiers that can change how your character plays entirely, some of them have trade-offs, some of them add a more simple and reliable change to your character, some are an insane amplification to a single ability, these are also random so choosing wisely when you get it is important, if you don't want to take them you can always choose cancel to get some cash refund to use at the shop to buy relics or upgrade perk levels.

Over all the game is really fun and addictive, as mentioned before there are some issues but they are minor issues as long as your connection is stable enough, there is some stuttering due to server issues, but if you don't mind the release of this game with small issues that will probably be fixed eventually then this game is really fun to just vibe with.

This game is nothing but grind.  You play the first level and what do you do right after?  Play the same level again a few more times at slightly higher difficulty while improving the time of your run to unlock the next difficulty of that same level, until you reach a high enough level ON THAT SAME LEVEL to unlock a new level.  That looks different than the last and has different bosses but really isn't all that different.  Then you repeat the process.  You repeat this process with a few bosses on each level and the same loop ad infinitum.  Your expected to play each level a ridiculous amount of times with the gameplay hardly varying at all.  The roguelight bonuses you get aren't really anything special that changes your gameplay much at all either.  Sure there are a couple of nice character models but this is bad game design and boring af.  At least its a free waste of time though.
